about: Bucket ids the storage service (packages/storage/src/bucket-rules.ts) and the server's built-in store (internal/objstore, cleanBucketID and refuseBucketID) judge alike. `refused` is refused by both; `refused_by_service` is refused by the service only, which also caps the length and does not trim. Plain data so the Go store's tests can read the same file.

refused.why: the store's own directory in another case
